entries: {@i A vast cavern is adorned with glowing fungi and striking stone formations. The Cavern card suggests exploration and delving into hidden secrets.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who asks probing questions but shares little.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature (such as a {@creature piercer} or a {@creature roper}) that mimics the features of natural caverns.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A cavern or a cavernous building such as a large temple.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A geode, jewelry made from gems and precious metals, or a magic item that grants {@sense darkvision} (such as {@item Goggles of Night}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires delving into hidden motivations and secrets.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who lives for the moment, avoiding introspection.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that swallows prey whole, or a trap that causes a ceiling or roof to collapse.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A small niche or cave.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that lacks a sense of depth or perspective.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Everyone's motivations exposed for all to see.

card.name: Celestial
entries: {@i A beautiful couatl twines through the clouds. This card suggests the involvement of celestial beings and service to the divine.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A devout person who looks for miracles and the presence of the divine in all parts of life.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Celestial or other creature that has connections to the gods, or a trap that deals radiant damage.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A location on the upper planes, or a place suffused with their influence.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting angels or other Celestials, treasure from the Upper Planes, or magic items made by Celestials.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Communication between the Upper Planes and the Material Plane—perhaps in dreams or visions, or with Celestials as intermediaries.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who carries a grudge over a real or perceived injury caused by a god or Celestial.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A fallen Celestial or similar creature that has lost its connection to the divine,

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place intended to ward off Celestials and influence from the Upper Planes.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure depicting a Celestial's fall, or a magic item useful against Celestials.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving Celestials' unwelcome interference in mortal affairs.

card.name: Comet
entries: {@i A comet with an enormous tail streaks across the winter sky at night, outshining the stars. The Comet card brings dire warnings or devastation.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A serious person with a gloomy outlook, perhaps carrying bad news.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature regarded as an ill omen, or signs that a dire creature approaches; alternatively, a trap marked by clear signs, perhaps surrounded by the corpses of its victims.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place with a connection to astronomical events: perhaps an observatory or a meteorite's crater.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that carries a curse, or one whose power is destined to be used for destructive ends.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A crisis about to spiral out of control.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who is grieving or delights in the suffering of others.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: The destruction left in the wake of a rampaging creature, or smaller creatures fleeing from a larger one.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A ruin where a terrible event occurred in the past and that might now be haunted.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: . A treasure formed or shaped by disaster, bloodstained or haunted by former owners: alternatively, something good arising from a bad situation.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: The calm after a devastating storm: a situation where people are reeling from awful news or events.

card.name: Construct
entries: {@i A modron wields a wrench in the interior of a clockwork machine. This card signifies things made by hand, including Constructs.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: An artisan who delights in handcrafted goods.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A construct, particularly designed to be animated (like a golem) as opposed to an ordinary object (like a {@creature animated broom|CM|broom} or {@creature rug of smothering|MM|rug}) that has been animated.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A workshop or art studio.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An exquisitely crafted art object (especially one with practical use) or magical tools.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An artisan attempting to bring a construct to life.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who scorns the idea of working with their hands.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature able to destroy buildings and objects, such as one with the Siege Monster trait.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A garbage heap or another place where objects are discarded.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An object fashioned with minimum alteration of its raw materials, or a magic item useful against Constructs (such as a {@item Mace of Smiting}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A rueful artisan attempting to destroy a Construct that has broken free of all restraint.

card.name: Corpse
entries: {@i An adventurer lies dead in a dungeon hallway, pierced by arrows. The Corpse card embodies decay and corruption.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: An evil person whose morality has rotted away.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A zombie or similar corporeal Undead whose flesh is decaying, or a trapped corpse.

items.name: Place
items.entry: Somewhere things are left to rot, such as a graveyard or charnel house.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting dead bodies, a corpse just starting to decay, or a magic item that causes decay (such as a {@item Staff of Withering}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An organization or institution overwhelmed by corruption.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A good person who remains uncorrupted despite being surrounded by wickedness.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Ooze or fungus creature that facilitates the decomposition of corpses.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where fungus grows abundantly on a diet of rotting flesh.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that remains uncorrupted in the midst of rot.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An attempt to corrupt a respected and noble organization.

card.name: Crossroads
entries: {@i A signpost points in many directions at a crossroads. The Crossroads card warns of a difficult but necessary decision.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person agonizing about a difficult decision or who regrets a recent decision.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that induces confusion or erratic behavior (such as an {@creature umber hulk}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A crossroads, or a settlement where trade routes cross.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that depicts a crossroads or cross patterns, or a magic item with multiple properties or uses (such as a staff).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A choice between options that are equally appealing—or equally disastrous.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who refuses to make decisions, relying instead on inaction or random determination.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that prevents others from acting (such as a {@creature ghoul}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that constrains movement, such as a narrow ravine or passage.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object featuring overlapping circular patterns, or a magic item that does only one thing a limited number of times (such as a wand).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation stemming from someone's refusal to act or choose.

card.name: Donjon
entries: {@i Underground stairs lead to a heavy door made of iron bars. This card represents both imprisonment and freedom.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A prisoner, or a person who feels trapped.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that grapples or swallows prey whole.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of imprisonment, such as a literal dungeon or a menagerie.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure locked in a vault, or magic with the power to bind or imprison.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An impasse, a situation that threatens someone's freedom, or a situation where someone's indecision is keeping everyone in suspense.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A recently freed or escaped prisoner, or a free thinker who rejects social norms.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that has escaped from captivity or gone feral.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A prison broken open, or a place associated with liberation (such as a monument commemorating emancipation).

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that once held a being captive, such as an {@item Efreeti Bottle} that has lost its magic or an empty {@item Iron Flask}.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires creative solutions, or an effort to free people or creatures from captivity.

card.name: Door
entries: {@i A large wooden door bars the path ahead. The card offers an opportunity to change.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone trying to make amends for past misdeeds and adopt a better way of life.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that changes form, or a trapped door.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A door, an open doorway, or a passage from one place to another.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that looks very different from various perspectives, or a magic item that creates portals or allows teleportation (such as an {@item Amulet of the Planes}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An opportunity to deal with a situation differently than you have in the past.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who keeps repeating the same mistakes and misdeeds.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that causes its prey or enemies to change, such as a lycanthrope or slaad.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A locked door or barricaded passage.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A jeweled chest or lockbox, or a magic item that resists change (such as an {@item Immovable Rod}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that keeps recurring.

card.name: Dragon
entries: {@i A menacing red dragon perches atop its treasure hoard inside a cave. This card can point to things connected to Dragons, but it also suggests hoarding, greed, and places rich in magical energy.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A dragonborn, a person who uses draconic magic, a person who is fascinated by dragons, or a person who hoards wealth or other goods.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Dragon or similar creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: The lair of a Dragon or some other impressive creature, or a site of great magical power.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: Large quantities of treasure, though not necessarily of great monetary value (for example, many copper coins or a large collection of cheap statuettes).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Someone hoarding resources that are widely needed or desired.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone with a grudge against a particular Dragon or against Dragons in general.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A dracolich or another Undead dragon, a Construct that resembles a Dragon, or another Dragon-like creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where a Dragon was slain, leaving a magical or physical scar on the land.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting the death of a Dragon, or a magic item useful against Dragons (such as a {@item Dragon Slayer}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A group that plans to drive a Dragon from its lair, steal from its hoard, or kill it.

card.name: Elemental
entries: {@i A hungry Xorn feeds in an Underdark cavern. This card suggests an Elemental creature or reducing a thing to its essence.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who uses magic tied to the elements or who is cartoonishly two-dimensional.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Elemental creature, or a creature that uses air, earth, fire, or water magic.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place influenced by the Elemental Planes or associated with an element (such as a cave, a mountain, a volcano, or a river).

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that incorporates material from an Elemental Plane or imagery of the elements, or a magic item that conjures or controls Elementals (such as a {@item Ring of Elemental Command}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Forces from the Elemental Planes spilling into the world.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person driven by an internal conflict between two opposed tendencies or influences.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature (such as a mephit) that combines the substance of two Elemental Planes, or creatures from opposing Elemental Planes.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where forces of the Elemental Planes are in opposition to each other.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that incorporates material from multiple Elemental Planes or imagery of elements in opposition; a magic item useful against Elementals.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Opposed forces from two or more Elemental Planes entering the world.

card.name: Euryale
entries: {@i A female medusa with a serpentine tail instead of legs is surrounded by flowers and herbs. The Euryale card points to vision, insight, and observation,}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who observes without becoming involved or attached,

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A {@creature medusa} or another creature with the power to petrify or a gaze attack.

items.name: Place
items.entry: Somewhere with commanding views, such as a watchtower or a high promontory.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A landscape painting or tapestry, or a magic item that enhances vision (such as {@item Goggles of Night}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that rewards or requires careful observation, such as a surveillance operation.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A nosy person who inserts themselves into situations where they don't belong.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature made of or associated with stone.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place with narrow windows (perhaps arrow slits) or with a limited view, perhaps underground.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable sculpture or statue, a gemstone, or a magic item made from stone, such as a {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power}.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation arising from people's unwillingness to observe things as they are, or their tendency to project their own feelings and opinions onto others.

card.name: Expert
entries: {@i A bard plays a musical instrument. This card implies expertise, rightly or wrongly applied.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person (perhaps a bard, a rogue, a ranger, or an artificer) with exactly the right skills for the task at hand.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature with abilities similar to those of a bard, ranger, or rogue, such as expertise in one or more skills.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place (such as a guild hall) where skilled folk gather to share their expertise.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure with practical use, such as a musical instrument or a tool.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires and rewards the expert application of practical skills.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who believes themself an expert but isn't actually helpful.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that relies on brute strength instead of skill or stealth.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where children learn the basics of useful skills.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A wildly impractical treasure with no actual use, unwieldy to wear or display.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation stemming from someone's expertise being overlooked or ignored.

card.name: Fates
entries: {@i Three sisters weave, measure, and cut the threads of fate. This card explores the repercussions of decisions and reflects on the past.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person perhaps nearing the end of their life, troubled by past mistakes or reflecting on prior decisions.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A supernatural creature connected to fate, such as a Celestial, modron, or hag.

items.name: Place
items.entry: Somewhere meant for literal or metaphorical reflection, such as a room full of mirrors, a still mountain lake, a monastery, a hermitage, or a library.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An ornate or magical mirror, tapestry, or other woven treasure; alternatively, magic that can alter fate.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation ordained by fate, perhaps involving a supernatural punishment or reward.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person driven by the desire to escape whatever fate has in store.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature strongly associated with chaos, such as a demon or a slaad.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that discourages reflection, such as a dark place or a noisy, busy one.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting the effort to escape fate, or a magic item powered by chaos.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An unjust situation where evil is rewarded and good is punished.

card.name: Fey
entries: {@i A blink dog runs through the wild. When upright; this card can refer to a Fey creature or a sense of whimsy; reversed, it points to the gloomy Shadowfell.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person with Fey ancestry or some other connection to the Fey (such as a {@creature warlock of the Archfey|MPMM}), or a person with a whimsical sense of humor.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Fey creature, or some other creature with connections to the Feywild.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place in the Feywild, somewhere that allows passage to the Feywild, or a location where Fey magic is active.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting Fey or the Feywild, or a magic item made by Fey.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An absurd situation that shouldn't be taken too seriously.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A gloomy person with no sense of humor, or a person who uses shadow-based magic.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature from the Shadowfell, or one transformed by shadow energy (such as a shadow dragon).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place in the Shadowfell, somewhere that allows passage to the Shadowfell, or a location where shadow magic is active.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting the Shadowfell, or a magic item that uses shadow magic.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A gloomy situation that offers little hope of success or escape.

card.name: Fiend
entries: {@i A balor strikes from the depths of the Abyss. This card alludes to an actual Fiend or the forces of the Lower Planes.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A tiefling, {@creature warlock of the Fiend|MPMM}, member of a Fiend-worshiping cult, or person who seeks to manipulate others into harmful contracts.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Fiend of any sort.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place on the Lower Planes, or a location suffused with their influence.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting Fiends, treasure from the Lower Planes, or magic items made by Fiends.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Interaction between the Lower Planes and the Material Plane perhaps an infernal bargain or demonic destruction.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who carries a grudge over a real or perceived injury caused by a Fiend, or a person trapped in a bargain with a Fiend.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A redeemed Fiend or similar creature that has lost its connection to the Lower Planes.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place intended to ward off Fiends and influence from the Lower Planes.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure depicting a Fiend's redemption, or a magic item useful against Fiends.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving Fiends' unwelcome interference in mortal affairs.

card.name: Flames
entries: {@i A chain devil, wreathed in flames, looks menacing and angry. The Flames card brings enemies and vengeance.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person carrying a bitter, possibly violent, grudge that poisons their outlook.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Fiend, a vengeful Undead (such as a {@creature ghost} or {@creature revenant}), or a creature dedicated to pursuing designated prey (such as an {@creature invisible stalker}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of bloodshed, or a place with a connection to the Lower Planes.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that has been the subject of intense discord or rivalry, or a magic item originating on the Lower Planes.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A deep-seated enmity that clouds the judgment of those involved, or someone's thirst for revenge.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who is being hunted or persecuted unjustly.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature fleeing from a larger or more dangerous foe.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of sanctuary for refugees and fugitives.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure symbolizing or commemorating the end of a feud or war, or a magic item that can charm or calm creatures (such as a {@item Rod of Rulership}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Unjust persecution or prejudicial hatred.

card.name: Fool
entries: {@i A person walks down a path, unwittingly dropping items along the way. The Fool card represents innocence.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: An innocent or naive person blissfully ignorant of the world's sinister side, possibly a child.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A naive Celestial or a flighty Fey, or a trap with a simple or obvious means of avoiding it.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place connected with children, such as a nursery, an orphanage, or a school.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A portrait of a child, jewelry meant for a child, or a magic item connected to the Upper Planes.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation requiring trust, honesty, and a leap of faith.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A con artist who preys on the innocent and gullible while presenting a trustworthy facade.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that changes shape to appear harmless so it can get close to its prey, or a trap that is difficult to avoid.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place tied to the loss of innocence, such as a harsh orphanage or exploitative workhouse.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure stolen from a child or naive person, or magic intended to deceive (such as a {@item Hat of Disguise}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A guileless person being manipulated by schemers.

card.name: Gem
entries: {@i A large, faceted gemstone set in intricate filigree gleams invitingly. The Gem card brings vast wealth.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who inherited wealth or whose wealth is the result of good fortune.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature connected with wealth, such as a Dragon or a {@creature Xorn}, or a treasure that doubles as a trap.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A mine or a treasure vault.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable treasure or a magical gem.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation driven by greed, such as siblings vying for an inheritance or someone hunting for a lost treasure.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who has lost wealth or power through a stroke of bad luck.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A trap or creature that uses the appearance of treasure as bait, such as a {@creature mimic}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place associated with poverty, such as a tenement or slum.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An item that appears valuable but isn't, or a magic item with a curse.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation stemming from the loss of wealth, such as a person trying to recover money given to a con artist or stolen by a thief.

card.name: Giant
entries: {@i A hungry troll lurks in a forest clearing. The Giant card indicates something very large or that looms large in one's perception.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A family member, a dear friend, or another personally important individual; alternatively, a very tall person.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Giant, a giant animal, or another big creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place constructed by Giants, or a place of great personal significance.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure made by Giants, or one of great sentimental value,

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Someone attaching outsize importance to one element of the situation, to the neglect of other factors.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who seems insignificant.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Tiny creature that's a greater threat than its size suggests.

items.name: Place
items.entry: Somewhere destroyed by Giants.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure depicting or commemorating the slaying of a Giant, or a magic item useful against Giants (such as a {@item Giant Slayer}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Someone unable or unwilling to recognize the importance of a critical factor.

card.name: Humanoid
entries: {@i Kobolds set a trap in their cave lair. This card points to the importance of empathy in relationships with other people.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: An empathetic person who's deeply concerned about the suffering of others.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A shapeshifter that takes on Humanoid appearance to blend in, perhaps to learn from them or to influence them toward good.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where diverse people live together in harmony.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure representing the collaboration of different artisans (such as a finely cut gem set in exquisite jewelry), or a magic item that facilitates peace and understanding.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that calls for empathy and compassion if it's to be resolved without violence.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who feels no empathy for others.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A shapeshifter that takes on Humanoid appearance to prey on Humanoids.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where people live apart from others, by choice or by force (such as a monastery or a cultural enclave).

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting or celebrating war; alternatively, a magic item made to be used in war, or that is especially useful against Humanoids.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A violent situation arising from a lack of empathy.

card.name: Jester
entries: {@i A person wearing jester's motley and holding a staff rests his foot on a skull. This card deals with the relationship between humor and misfortune.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: An optimistic person who laughs at their own misfortune.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A monster some consider silly, such as a {@creature flumph}, an {@creature owlbear}, or a {@creature gelatinous cube}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place dedicated to amusement, such as a fairground or a feasting hall.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A humorous art object or magic item, such as a {@item Wand of Wonder}.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A hilarious situation stemming from miscommunication and misplaced assumptions.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who laughs at the misfortunes of others.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature with an unsettling laugh, such as a {@creature gnoll} or {@creature hyena}, or a creature with a cruel sense of humor.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place associated with cruelty and pain, such as a torture chamber.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting pain or humiliation, or a magic item meant to inflict pain (such as a {@item Sword of Wounding}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: One misfortune piling on another in a way that would be humorous—if it weren't disastrous.

card.name: Key
entries: {@i This large metal key is bizarrely complicated. The Key card represents the perfect solution to a problem or having the right tool for the job.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person with the skills or tools needed to solve the current problem.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that preys on the party's weaknesses, or a trap that can be disarmed only with a key.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place through which only certain people are allowed to pass, or where a key is required.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A magic item needed to overcome an obstacle or defeat an enemy, or the means to unlock a treasure (such as a {@item Chime of Opening}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that can be resolved successfully only by taking a specific action.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person ill equipped for the challenges they face.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature with vulnerabilities, or a trap that's bizarrely complex.

items.name: Place
items.entry: An open and easily accessed place.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure in a locked container, or magic that slows creatures.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that can be successfully resolved in many ways.

card.name: Knight
entries: {@i A knight formed of folded cards offers a sword also made from cards. The Knight card signifies trust and loyalty.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A trustworthy person who honors their commitments.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature bound by oaths or who serves someone else.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of sanctuary, where strong traditions protect those who take shelter inside.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure celebrating or commemorating an oath (such as a wedding ring), or magic weapons or armor associated with knights or paladins.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires loyalty in one's companions and faithfulness to them.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who can't be trusted, or a traitor posing as a loyal friend.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A knight who has failed to live up to their code of honor (such as a {@creature death knight}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where a great betrayal took place, or a location with treacherous terrain or traps.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that carries a hidden curse, or a magic item that fails when it's needed most.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving the betrayal of trust, or rampant suspicion.

card.name: Lance
entries: {@i An ornate dragonlance shines among more ordinary weapons on a rack. The Lance card warns that healing sometimes requires additional injury, as when infection must be cut away.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A surgeon, or someone (such as a guard or soldier) who uses violence in pursuit of worthy societal goals.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature trained to fight alongside guards or soldiers.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where surgery is performed.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure made at great cost, or a magic weapon.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation in which additional pain is required to bring healing.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person committed to pacifism or avoiding harm,

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature uninterested in fighting, or a trap that restrains but doesn't cause damage.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where violence is forbidden.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure celebrating the end of hostilities or the ideal of peace, or a magic item intended to prevent or end conflict.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation complicated by people avoiding any hint of conflict.

card.name: Mage
entries: {@i A warlock holds a black crystalline staff. This card suggests both mental acuity and arcane magic.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person (perhaps a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard) who uses arcane magic or other specialized learning.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature with abilities similar to those of a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place dedicated to the study of arcane magic or that is suffused with such magic.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A magic item such as a wand or staff, or a wizard's spellbook.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires and rewards the correct use of arcane magic.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who wrongly believes their good luck is the result of innate magical ability or a magical good luck charm.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that resists or negates magic.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where magic has caused destruction, doesn't work (like the effect of an {@spell Antimagic Field}), or works unpredictably (perhaps triggering {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB|wild magic surges}).

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object created by the use of magic, or a magic item with unpredictable effects (such as a {@item Wand of Wonder}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation caused by magic misused or out of control.

card.name: Map
entries: {@i X marks the spot on an elaborate treasure map. The Map card provides guidance that leads to the goal of the quest.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who acts as a guide, showing the way forward.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that tracks by scent.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A path or road.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable map (perhaps a jeweled globe or rare atlas), or a magic item that provides direction.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation best navigated with a guide.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who tries to lead you on the wrong path.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature (such as a {@creature will-o'-wisp}) that leads travelers astray.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A demiplane or similar place that can't be found on maps, or a location hidden behind a secret door.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure from another plane of existence, or a magic item that creates or accesses an extradimensional space (like a {@item Portable Hole}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: No guide or direction is available.

card.name: Maze
entries: {@i Unfortunate souls are trapped in an elaborate and impossible maze of cards. Those who draw the Maze card are lost.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who feels lost in their own life, unsure how to affect change, or a person with a wandering mind who takes their time getting to the point.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A minotaur or another creature that hunts in a maze or is imprisoned in a maze.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A maze, or a region (such as a forest or desert) where becoming lost is very easy.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting confusion or disorientation, or a magic item that can cause these states.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A confusing situation where it's difficult to perceive all the factors at play.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person running from expectations placed on them by family and society, trying to find a new path in life.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature whose behavior is unpredictable.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A simple labyrinth designed for meditation or to provide private nooks, or a location in which one is unlikely to get lost (such as a cave with only one exit).

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object incorporating a labyrinth design.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A search for something or someone that has gone missing.

card.name: Mine
entries: {@i A well-crafted pick leans against a wall at the entrance to a mine. The Mine card represents something valuable underground or buried in the earth.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A miner or an archaeologist.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that burrows underground, especially one that delves into the earth in search of prey (such as a {@creature giant weasel}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A mine, an archaeological dig, or a similar excavated site.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure from the earth, such as metal ore or gems, or any treasure that has been buried and unearthed.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Something unearthed that should have remained buried.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who places things in the earth, such as a gardener or an undertaker.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that lives underground but hunts above ground (such as an {@creature ankheg} or a {@creature bulette}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that has sunk into the earth, perhaps swallowed in a sinkhole or covered in a mudslide.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure buried in the earth.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: The retrieval of something buried.

card.name: Monstrosity
entries: {@i An owlbear sits in a sunny glade. This card represents something monstrous, including familiar things that turn strange and threatening.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A familiar person whose behavior suddenly turns threatening.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Monstrosity, especially one that superficially resembles an ordinary animal or person (such as a {@creature displacer beast} or {@creature doppelganger}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A familiar place that has become dangerous.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting a Monstrosity or that incorporates claws, fur, or feathers from such a creature.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving something or someone becoming more monstrous (literally or figuratively).

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who seems dangerous or bizarre but is friendly and helpful.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Monstrosity that is a potential ally, such as a {@creature hippogriff}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that offers refuge in unfamiliar or dangerous terrain.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A dead Monstrosity preserved by taxidermy, or a magic item useful against Monstrosities.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Something that appears monstrous but is actually benign.

card.name: Moon
entries: {@i A crescent moon looms large in the autumn sky. The Moon card points to hidden potential.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone whose fine qualities are masked by one annoying trait.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A lycanthrope, or a creature that appears to be an inanimate object until it strikes (such as a {@creature gargoyle}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A secret chamber or a place concealed by terrain; alternatively, a place larger or more elaborate on the inside than it seems from outside.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure whose value isn't immediately apparent, or a magic item that appears to be a worthless object.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A problem that requires investigation and is more complicated than it appears.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who seems competent but bungles everything they attempt.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that uses its fearsome appearance to frighten away others because it is too weak to fight.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place with an impressive exterior but a dingy, poorly maintained interior.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that seems more valuable than it is, perhaps an ordinary item that falsely appears magical.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that seems—and is—too good to be true.

card.name: Ooze
entries: {@i A gelatinous cube with various items suspended inside it creeps through a vaulted sewer. The Ooze card indicates the importance of something that seems lowly or innocuous.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A quiet, unassuming person who has hidden power or secret knowledge.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Ooze or another creature that seems unimportant, or a trap that is surprisingly simple and straightforward.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A humble place of surprising comfort or importance.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that is valuable but not beautiful, such as a poorly crafted piece of jewelry incorporating precious stones.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Something important that has been overlooked because it seems ordinary.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A quiet, unassuming person completely out of their depth.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Ooze that has developed curiosity, unexpected intelligence, and a way to communicate, or a dangerous trap that is difficult to detect.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A humble place with little to offer.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting an ooze or the destruction of a particularly notable Ooze; alternatively, a magic item useful against Oozes (such as a {@item Ring of Acid Resistance}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation complicated by the sheer number of minor factors tangled within it.

card.name: Path
entries: {@i A well-worn path twists through the wilderness, with hidden dangers lurking in the shadows to both sides. This card suggests the importance of sticking with a plan and remaining focused on the destination.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A goal-oriented person who knows exactly what they want and has a clear plan to get it.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature single-mindedly pursuing prey or some other goal, or a trapped room navigable by only a single path.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A road or trail.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting a road or path, or a magic item that allows divination (such as a {@item Crystal Ball} or a {@item Spell Scroll (6th Level)|DMG|Spell Scroll} of {@spell Find the Path}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that demands unwavering focus on the goal.

items.name: Person
items.entry: An aimless person who doesn't know what they want and has no idea how to decide.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that reacts to provocation without a clear plan or purpose; it might be acting on instinct or be confused.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A trackless wilderness, or an underground complex that is very difficult to traverse.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An abstract art object, or a magic item that foils divination (such as an {@item Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A series of distractions that deflect attention from an important goal.

card.name: Pit
entries: {@i A deep hole studded with spikes gapes in the earth. The Pit card represents a literal or metaphorical fall—losing status, wealth, or position.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who has lost significant wealth, social status, or favor.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A pit trap, or a scavenger lurking at the bottom of a pit.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A pit or cliff that creates the risk of a fall.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting someone's calamitous fall, or a magic item that allows falling safely (such as a {@item Ring of Feather Falling}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving someone's fall from grace.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person in a precarious position who soon will have a calamitous fall.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature (such as a {@creature piercer}) that attacks by falling on prey.

items.name: Place
items.entry: An abandoned mansion or palace that is in disrepair due to the owner's downfall.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting flight or incorporating feathers, or a magic item that grants flight (such as {@item Winged Boots} or a {@item Cloak of the Bat}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A conspiracy to cause the downfall of a wealthy or prominent person.

card.name: Plant
entries: {@i A myconid emits a cloud of spores. The Plant card reflects growth and natural life.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who lives in the wilderness among trees and other growing things.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Plant creature, or a creature that facilitates the growth of wild plants.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A verdant place where vegetation grows wild, untouched by people's hands.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object crafted from wood or incorporating leaves; alternatively, a magic item that allows uncontrolled vegetation growth (such as a {@item Bag of Beans}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Something growing out of control with surprising, even supernatural, speed.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A quiet person who enjoys gardening or farming, finding greenery more relatable than people.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A domesticated plant given artificial animation, such as an {@creature awakened tree} or {@creature awakened shrub|MM|shrub}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place full of carefully pruned and neatly controlled vegetation, such as a topiary garden.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that incorporates living greenery, such as an ornate terrarium or a potted topiary, or a magic item that allows control of vegetation (such as a {@item Staff of the Woodlands}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A conflict between a region suffering a famine and a region with abundant crops.

card.name: Priest
entries: {@i A cleric holds a heavy mace. The Priest card represents wisdom, insight, closeness to the divine, and divine magic.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person (perhaps a cleric, druid, or paladin) who uses divine magic or is very pious.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature with abilities similar to those of a cleric, druid, or paladin.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A temple, shrine, or similar place consecrated to a deity or natural force.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A magic item such as a {@item Staff of Healing} or a {@item Holy Avenger}; alternatively, valuable temple accouterments.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A problem that requires and rewards piety or the use of divine magic.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person devoted to a false god, or a cause that isn't worthy of devotion.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A demon or another creature opposed to the gods.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that was consecrated but that has been abandoned or converted to secular use.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An idol depicting an invented god or a demon lord.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation caused by impiety or misguided zealotry.

card.name: Prisoner
entries: {@i A rogue begs for release from a dank prison cell. The Prisoner card represents someone or something locked and hidden away.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person held captive or bound by expectations.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature locked away to prevent it from harming people.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where things are put to keep them out of reach and memory.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure securely locked away, or a magic item that contains a creature (such as an {@item Elemental Gem} or an {@item Iron Flask}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation arising from efforts to keep a person, an object, or information out of reach.

items.name: Person
items.entry: An individual who defies societal norms and expectations.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that grapples, swallows, or otherwise binds or imprisons its prey.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where something or someone is kept on public display.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A prominently displayed treasure, such as a ruler's regalia.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: The theft or liberation of a person, or an object on public display.

card.name: Puzzle
entries: {@i An elaborate puzzle box floats in the air, glowing from within. The Puzzle card speaks to intelligence and strategic thinking.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person with a keen mind for puzzles, or one who delights in clever banter and wordplay.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A brilliant creature that relies on careful plans and tactics rather than brute strength, or a trap that can be bypassed by solving a puzzle or riddle.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place with hidden doors and other secrets.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure whose function or value isn't immediately apparent.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A complex situation with many interconnected factors.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who is very literal and direct.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that delights in straightforward melee combat, relying on strength to overpower its foes.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place with a simple, symmetrical floor plan.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: Coins or other treasure whose value is obvious and almost universally understood.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that's exactly what it appears to be.

card.name: Ring
entries: {@i An emerald ring glows within a decorative jewelry box. The Ring card suggests both a promise and the honor involved in keeping it.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone scrupulously faithful to a promise.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that has promised to serve someone.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where oaths are sworn, such as a temple or courthouse.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A ring, either jewelry or a magic item.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation complicated by a person's promise to do something.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who resents being bound to an oath sworn in haste or duress.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature unwillingly bound to serve someone (such as an {@creature invisible stalker}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where a legendary figure was coerced into swearing an oath that led to their downfall.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A bracelet or magic bracers.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation arising from someone trying to abjure an oath.

card.name: Rogue
entries: {@i A roguish kenku lurking in the shadows holds a dagger, poised to strike. This card suggests treachery and deception.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A deceptive person hiding a sinister secret; pursuit of their own aims trumps any friendship or loyalty.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A dangerous creature that strikes by surprise or from darkness.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A front for a criminal operation, or a monster's lair.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that hides a deadly secret, such as a ring with a spring-loaded poison needle, a {@item Dagger of Venom}, or a cursed magic item.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation rooted in or destined for betrayal.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A good-hearted person entangled in a criminal or evil organization who is desperate for a way out.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature unwillingly bound to the service of villains.

items.name: Place
items.entry: An oasis of compassion surrounded by violence.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure caked in grime or hidden in a filthy place.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Good characters who are part of an evil organization or who plot to subvert it.

card.name: Ruin
entries: {@i An elegant sword and crown disintegrate into eddies of ash. The Ruin card warns of the inevitability of decay and the danger of material attachments.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who has renounced material attachments, such as a religious ascetic.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that destroys equipment, such as a {@creature rust monster} or a {@creature black pudding}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A ruin, or a retreat for ascetics.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that is broken or in disrepair.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving the decay of objects or relationships over a long period of time.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person excessively attached to material goods (not necessarily excessive wealth).

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Construct, especially an animated object.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place meant to store goods, such as a warehouse or an armory.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: Valuable trade goods, well-made equipment, or a deed to property.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving the production or transportation of goods for sale.

card.name: Sage
entries: {@i The mind of a sage is filled with obscure lore gained through exhaustive research. This card represents well-intentioned advice.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who offers helpful advice in difficult circumstances.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A helpful creature that leads the way to safety or a goal.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place dedicated to knowledge and wisdom, such as a library or university.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable or magical book or scroll, or a sentient magic item that is known to provide helpful advice.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An opportunity to provide valuable advice on a familiar subject.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who helpfully offers bad advice.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that tries to lead the way into danger or a trap.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place whose structural flaws threaten its integrity.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A device valuable for its components that doesn't function as intended, or a sentient magic item that provides bad but well-intentioned advice.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An opportunity to provide advice on a completely unfamiliar subject.

card.name: Shield
entries: {@i A circular shield is close at hand in a military barrack. The Shield card is a reminder of the need for protection.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A protective parent or sibling, or a professional protector such as a sentry or guard.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that protects others, such as a watchdog or {@creature shield guardian}, or a warding trap designed to repel invaders.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A defensive structure, such as a fortress or a castle wall.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable or magical shield.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Someone who must protect those who can't protect themselves.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A guarded person who carefully shields themself from physical or emotional harm.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A heavily armored creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A hermitage or retreat meant to isolate one person from others.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A suit of armor that is valuable or magical.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation arising from someone selfishly protecting themself without heed to others.

card.name: Ship
entries: {@i A three-masted ship with a couatl figurehead sails across the open sea. The Ship card indicates a long journey, not necessarily by sea.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who routinely travels long distances, such as a sailor, pilgrim, or nomad.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that hunts a large territory or migrates great distances.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A port city, harbor, caravansary, or similar hub for travelers.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting ships or travel, or a magic item that facilitates travel (such as a {@item Folding Boat}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires travel, or one that unfolds while traveling,

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who dreams of travel but has never wandered far from home.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that rarely leaves its lair—and is more powerful there.

items.name: Place
items.entry: An isolated place that rarely sees travelers.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure still in the hands of the person who made it, or a magic item (such as {@item Dimensional Shackles}) that prevents magical movement.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation arising from someone's inability or unwillingness to travel.

card.name: Skull
entries: {@i A skeletal figure is shrouded in a swirling robe, though its skull is clearly visible. The Skull card is a reminder of the universality of death—and the fact that everyone must confront death alone.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person facing imminent death, or one who wields necromantic power.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Undead creature, or a trap that deals necrotic damage.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of solitude and isolation, or a place where someone died recently.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure associated with death (perhaps funerary implements), or a magic item with necromantic power.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A person's life in peril.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone haunted by the inevitability of death and seeking to escape it, or a person who has returned from death.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An immortal creature or one that doesn't age, such as an angel, a Fiend, or a naga.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A graveyard or another place where the dead are gathered.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that celebrates or depicts deliverance from death, or a magic item that wards off death (such as a {@item Periapt of Wound Closure} or a {@item Scarab of Protection}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Many lives at stake.

card.name: Staff
entries: {@i An elegant black staff leans against a wall, waiting for its owner to return. The Staff card represents support or assistance.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who offers physical, financial, or emotional support.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature used as a mount or a tracker, or another sort of ally.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where support is offered or found, such as a library or a tavern.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A magic staff, a jeweled cane or mobility aid, or a similar treasure.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A group or organization that offers much-needed support.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person in desperate need of assistance.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that's helpless or ineffective unless it can possess or be carried by another creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place in immediate crisis, such as a location suddenly imperiled by fire or flood.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that needs repair before regaining its full value or magical potency.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A group of people who need help from others.

card.name: Stairway
entries: {@i A spiral stairway leads both up and down, but the downward stairs are cluttered and dark. This card points to a change in difficulty, either increasing or decreasing.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who makes every task more difficult than it needs to be, adding complications and getting in the way.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that grows in power as battle continues (such as a {@creature black pudding} or a {@creature hydra}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place reached by descending stairs, such as a basement or a lower level of a dungeon.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An intricate treasure that was difficult to create, or a magic item that helps accomplish difficult tasks (such as an {@item Ioun Stone, Mastery|DMG|Ioun Stone of Mastery}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation more complicated or challenging than it appears.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A helpful, friendly person who makes everything easier (or at least more pleasant).

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that is difficult to fight at first, but that becomes easier to defeat as the battle proceeds.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place reached by ascending stairs, such as an attic or upper level of a dungeon.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that is simple and elegant.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation much simpler than it appears,

card.name: Star
entries: {@i A brilliant star shines in the spring sky at twilight. The Star card represents inherent ability and training working in concert—nature allied with nurture.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person focused on improving a particular area of skill or behavior.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that has trained to improve itself (perhaps having several skill or saving throw proficiencies), or a trap that requires teamwork to avoid or escape.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place dedicated to study or training, such as a university or gymnasium.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that reflects the skill of its creator, or a magic item that grants proficiency.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires or rewards training and practice.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person with natural ability but little patience for training or study.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that relies on its natural abilities instead of training (perhaps with no skill or saving throw proficiencies).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of untouched natural beauty.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: Unrefined ore or uncut gems, or a magic item that improves an ability score.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation resulting from someone's refusal to practice or train.

card.name: Statue
entries: {@i A statue depicts the god Istus offering the original {@item Deck of Many Things|DMG} as a gift. The Statue card is a reminder of the past.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone who takes great pride in a prominent ancestor.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An ancient creature that played an important part in a historical event.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A park or plaza built around a statue.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A statuette or sculpture, either valuable or magical (such as a {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation with remarkable similarities to a significant historical event.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who lives in the shadow of a famous or important ancestor.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that clings to a memory of fallen glory (such as a {@creature storm giant} or a {@creature mind flayer}), a creature in the guise of a statue (such as a {@creature mimic}), or a statue that functions as a trap.

items.name: Place
items.entry: An immense ruin left behind by an ancient civilization.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object made in imitation of a more famous and valuable piece.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An attempt to re-create a historical situation or rebuild a fallen empire.

card.name: Sun
entries: {@i A sun blazes brightly in the summer sky. The Sun card brings hope—either well-founded or deluded.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person with an unflappable and optimistic outlook, confident in the power of good triumphing over evil and obstacles.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An angel or a similar creature that embodies hope and good.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that embodies hope in the face of despair, such as a temple next to a graveyard or a town rebuilding after a natural disaster.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable religious object devoted to good, or a holy or protective magic item.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A difficult situation where hope nevertheless continues to shine like a beacon.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A naively positive person who spouts empty platitudes about everything turning out for the best.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature (perhaps a {@creature flumph} or a {@creature pixie}) that offers aid but is too weak to provide meaningful help.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A desecrated temple or similar place where dirt or corruption has eliminated all evidence of goodness and holiness.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A religious object or holy magic item that has been desecrated.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Idealistic optimism that prevents people from responding to real danger.

card.name: Talons
entries: {@i A clawed hand reaches to grab an emerald ring which disintegrates at the claw's approach. The Talons card indicates greed or the rapacious hunger of a predator.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who preys on other folk to acquire wealth or power.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A predator, especially one that preys on people or slowly drains their life (such as a {@creature vampire}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place where the rich benefit from the labor of the poor.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that is a collector's prized possession or the object of a heist.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation driven by someone's avarice.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person trapped by predatory debt or victimized by a monster that slowly drains the person's life.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature hunted for parts of its body that are considered valuable, or for the treasure it hoards.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A tenement or workhouse where oppressed victims of the rich live in squalor.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure that was stolen from its rightful owner.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation driven by a desperate individual victimized by the greedy.

card.name: Tavern
entries: {@i An adventuring party eats and laughs in a busy tavern. The Tavern card points to the pleasure of spending time with friends.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A genial person who delights in telling stories in good company.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A social creature that travels in packs.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A tavern, restaurant, or similar place where people gather and eat socially.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A jeweled goblet or other treasure related to eating and drinking.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A tavern brawl.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who ruins the happiness of pleasant company.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A parasite, {@creature vampire}, or similar creature that siphons strength, happiness, or vitality from others, or a trap designed to separate those caught in it.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place once used for social gatherings but now abandoned.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A jeweled goblet or similar treasure stained with blood or holding the remnants of poison.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An attempt to kill many people at once as they gather for a meal.

card.name: Temple
entries: {@i A temple invites worshipers into the serene space within. The Temple card suggests the comfort found in ritual and communion with the divine.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A devout person who performs frequent rituals to invoke divine favor.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A temple guardian—perhaps a Celestial, Construct, or {@creature guardian naga}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A temple, shrine, or other place of worship.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable ritual object, such as a candelabra or sacrificial knife, or a magic item linked to worship or divine magic (such as a {@item Candle of Invocation}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation best resolved by an appeal to divine power or spiritual authorities.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A superstitious person who performs frequent rituals to ward off supernatural evil.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that bestows curses (such as a {@creature fomorian}, {@creature rakshasa}, or {@creature mummy}).

items.name: Place
items.entry: An area where crime, vice, or other impious behaviors are widespread.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure with superstitious meaning perhaps an amulet meant to ward off evil (such as a {@item Scarab of Protection}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation stemming from a superstitious fear of curses or bad luck.

card.name: Throne
entries: {@i An ostentatious throne stands on a dais, with a crown on the seat and a ceremonial sword leaning against one armrest. This card represents the authority of worldly rulers.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who enjoys exercising authority over others and expects to be obeyed.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that leads others of its kind; alternatively, one with magical powers of influence or command.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of authority, such as a palace or a mayor's office.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A ruler's regalia, or a magic item (such as a {@item Rod of Rulership}) that imparts magical authority.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A contest over who rightfully holds authority.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who resents authority imposed on them.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that unwillingly serves another.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place at the edge of a ruler's authority or on the border between rival nations.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object created as an act of resistance to tyranny, or a magic item that protects against restraint (such as a {@item Ring of Free Action}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A group of people rebelling against a ruler or an authority figure.

card.name: Tomb
entries: {@i A burial chamber holds a plain stone casket. The Tomb card suggests buried secrets and things long forgotten.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person with a secret or a gap in their memory.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A {@creature mummy}, {@creature wight}, or similar Undead that lairs in its own tomb.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A tomb, especially one that is forgotten.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: Valuable or magical funerary treasure.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation no one wants to talk about or even acknowledge.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person trying to atone for a dreadful secret in their past.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An incorporeal Undead (such as a {@creature wraith} or {@creature specter}) that's not linked to the place of its death, burial place, or body.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A memorial structure that doesn't contain a body.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting a dead individual as they were in life.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation stemming from a buried secret that recently came to light.

card.name: Tower
entries: {@i A tall, ornate tower made of black stone looms over a desolate landscape. The Tower card represents isolation.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who prefers solitude to the company of others.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A reclusive creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A remote tower or similar place of isolation.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting an isolated place or a lonely person; alternatively, {@item Daern's Instant Fortress} or a similar magic item.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires assistance or information from a reclusive person.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A desperately lonely person who craves close companionship.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature cut off from others of its kind that is trying to find them, or a trap that targets a single creature.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place that discourages interaction with others, such as a library or monastery, where rules of silence are strictly enforced.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object expressing the artist's profound loneliness.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation arising from someone's loneliness or boredom.

card.name: Tree
entries: {@i A tree has broken through a fortress wall and reclaimed part of the keep. This card suggests perseverance in difficult circumstances.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A strong-willed person determined to persevere despite hostile conditions.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that thrives in a hostile environment.

items.name: Place
items.entry: Somewhere vegetation makes an unexpected appearance: a park in a busy urban center or a tree growing on barren rock.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure featuring diamonds, pearls, or precious wood, or a magic item that increases endurance (such as an {@item Amulet of Health}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A small outpost or lone individual holding back a much larger force.

items.name: Person
items.entry: Someone barely hanging on in hostile conditions.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature driven from its preferred environment and struggling to survive in a new region.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place cleared of natural growth.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object or a magic item made from the wood of a tree struck by lightning.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: An overwhelming threat against a small outpost or lone individual.

card.name: Undead
entries: {@i A lich beckons souls of the dead. This card can point to anything that refuses to die, from old grudges and unresolved issues to Undead creatures.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person nursing a grudge beyond reason.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Undead creature sustained by a thirst for revenge or an unfinished task, such as a {@creature ghost} or {@creature revenant}.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place haunted (literally or emotionally) by a terrible event that happened there.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure depicting the dead or an Undead, something made from bones, or a magic item made by or for an Undead.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: Someone who refuses to leave the past in the past.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person too quick to forgive and forget, who never holds anyone accountable for their misdeeds.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: An Undead creature that craves an end to its miserable, interminable existence.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place whose denizens have forgotten significant events that happened there.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object depicting the destruction of an Undead, or a magic item particularly useful against Undead (such as a {@item Mace of Disruption}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A serial criminal who has been pardoned for past misdeeds and now continues their wicked ways.

card.name: Void
entries: {@i An endless void seems to spiral toward a central hole that devours all. This card spells disaster.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person trapped in despair.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A Fiend or an Undead that threatens annihilation of body and soul, or a trap with no easy exit or escape.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place deep underground, underwater, or in space, where little light and air are available.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An art object that reflects its creator's despair or sadness, or a {@item Sphere of Annihilation}.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that seems to have no good or even survivable outcome.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person who has lost everything and has no place left to go but up.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A {@creature skeleton}, {@creature zombie}, or similar Undead remnant of a living creature; alternatively, a trap that's broken and nonfunctional.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A place of utter carnage, where a terrible battle or massacre took place.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A treasure promised but not actually present, such as an empty treasure chest or a looted vault.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: The aftermath of a destructive event, where the few survivors must figure out how to go on living.

card.name: Warrior
entries: {@i A barbarian holds a greataxe. The Warrior card embodies physical strength and fighting acumen.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A person (perhaps a barbarian, fighter, or monk) who has trained in combat or served in the military.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature with abilities like those of a barbarian, fighter, or monk.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A training yard or fort where warriors learn combat skills.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A valuable or magical weapon or suit of armor.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation that requires and rewards the skilled application of physical force.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A bully who uses physical strength to intimidate others.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A creature that relies on brute strength, or a trap that can be escaped through the application of brute strength.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A harsh environment where only the physically powerful survive.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: An unsubtle work of art.

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A situation involving bullying or extortion.

card.name: Well
entries: {@i A stone well stands in a peaceful meadow, surrounded by wildflowers. The Well card speaks of drawing resources from familiar places.}

items.name: Person
items.entry: A familiar person who is a reliable source of information and aid.

items.name: Creature or Trap
items.entry: A familiar kind of creature, whose abilities are well understood.

items.name: Place
items.entry: A well, a familiar shop, or a place where fresh water can be found.

items.name: Treasure
items.entry: A reliable treasure (such as gold coins), or a magic item that produces food or water (such as a {@item Decanter of Endless Water} or an {@item Alchemy Jug}).

items.name: Situation
items.entry: A familiar situation with a predictable outcome.

items.name: Person
items.entry: A familiar person who refuses to provide expected aid.
