card.name: Ace of Charisma
entries: A new opportunity and a time of manifestation and abundance.
{@i A mysterious order of assassins begins to hunt down a member of the party.}

card.name: Ace of Intelligence
entries: Finding your inner wizard and using your genius to discover new ideas and have breakthroughs.
{@i The party meets a powerful Wizard whom they may ask one question and get a truthful answer from.}

card.name: Ace of Strength
entries: The source of all creative energy is within you. You have the power to imagine, begin and complete any project you set your mind to.
{@i A nobleman's children have run away to join the Lord Montague's Monstrous Circus. He begs that you find and return them.}

card.name: Ace of Wisdom
entries: Our ability to access the power of insight to heal emotions and love ourselves.
{@i A group of elves asks if the party would aid them in recovering a sacred artifact.}

card.name: Death
entries: The transformation from one perceptual reality to another and the ending of habitual patterns
{@i A vampire Lord offers you the gift of eternal undeath in exchange for a single favor.}

card.name: Eight of Charisma
entries: Paying attention to doing the simple things well. Slow and steady wins the race.
{@i A dwarven forgemaster has had her magical hammer stolen and is asking for your help. In return, she'll forge you a weapon.}

card.name: Eight of Intelligence
entries: Entangling ourselves from guilty thoughts and self-punishment.
{@i A nearby village has been invaded by the drow and seeks aid.}

card.name: Eight of Strength
entries: Going with the flow and adapting to change. Hold the goal loosely and enjoy the journey.
{@i During a lightning storm, the adventurers see an entrance to a cavern. It is home to a coven of hags.}

card.name: Eight of Wisdom
entries: Finding a way out of past pain by having faith that something better is waiting for you.
{@i Graves of a cemetery appear to be robbed, but some say it was the dead that dug their way out.}

card.name: Five of Charisma
entries: Finding out how to move out of lack mentality and to enjoy the abundance, in whatever form, showing up in our lives.
{@i A kobold asks if the party wishes to join him on an adventure to the Dragon's Teeth mountains to find the fabled Eye of Tiamat.}

card.name: Five of Intelligence
entries: The ways in which competition breeds conflict and divides us to create suffering.
{@i The adventurers encounter two nobles fighting over a magical (but cursed) item.}

card.name: Five of Strength
entries: Being focused totally on being in the moment to work together effectively. Letting go of competition.
{@i A traveling circus's giant spider has died, leaving its owner distraught. Can you get some giant spider eggs for him to hatch?}

card.name: Five of Wisdom
entries: Keeping a bright outlook and not letting past pain affect your interpretation of the present moment.
{@i A revenant tells you its story and asks for aid in completing its act of vengeance.}

card.name: Four of Charisma
entries: Being careful with finances while not falling into fear or greed.
{@i A dwarf claims to have discovered a vein of mithral in his mine, but now monsters have moved in, and he needs help reclaiming it.}

card.name: Four of Intelligence
entries: Taking time to meditate before moving forward while making sure you are not avoiding action.
{@i The next short rest you take acts as a long rest instead.}

card.name: Four of Strength
entries: The whole is greater than the sum of its parts. Seek out others to collaborate with.
{@i The mayor of a small town has declared tieflings a "threat to moral decency" and wants them rounded up and detained.}

card.name: Four of Wisdom
entries: Taking time to meditate and let go of all the noisy thoughts that are in your head.
{@i You discover a treasure map within an ornate box in the hollow of an old tree.}

card.name: Judgement
entries: Our capability to discern what is truly important and to use it to weed the garden of our life.
{@i A hill giant is sleeping off a night of drinking. Inside a chain mail pouch on its belt, you can hear someone whispering for help.}

card.name: Justice
entries: Your capacity to create a new reality through shattering old, limiting beliefs.
{@i A poor villager comes to you seeking aid and offers you a rare magic item in compensation.}

card.name: King of Charisma
entries: Reaping the fruits of your endeavours. Enjoying abundance while not getting lost in acquiring.
{@i Is there a bard in the party? The king is having a ball and the entertainment has not shown up.}

card.name: King of Intelligence
entries: Using the panels of your intellect clearly without letting it override your heart.
{@i A queen has fallen under a witch's curse. You have been asked to help break the spell.}

card.name: King of Strength
entries: Fully expressing your powers of leadership and realising your vision. Teaching others.
{@i While traveling, the party comes across a nest of yuan-ti that are planning on enslaving a nearby village.}

card.name: King of Wisdom
entries: Fully accepting this moment. Allowing complaints to dissolve. Being kind to yourself.
{@i A noble approaches you and says that an assassin has been sent to kill him and he needs your help.}

card.name: Knight of Charisma
entries: Finding a way to enjoy routine, take responsibility for our own success, and let go of expectations. Good work speaks for itself.
{@i The local mad wizard wants basilisk or cockatrice eggs and is willing to pay handsomely.}

card.name: Knight of Intelligence
entries: Channelling raw ambition into a constructive thoughtful and focused plan.
{@i A holy order needs your aid to sanctify a place defiled by demons.}

card.name: Knight of Strength
entries: Going full out and not looking back. Following your gut. Doing what it takes to make it happen.
{@i The adventurers find a sending stone. On the other end is someone who is in deep trouble and is pleading for help.}

card.name: Knight of Wisdom
entries: Trusting your passion, allowing yourself to dream big, and imagining the best happening for you.
{@i There were whispers that the mayor of the town was seen signing a pact with an imp.}

card.name: Nine of Charisma
entries: The capability to come out of "survival mode" and enjoy the abundance and self-sufficiency that we do have. Appreciate the good.
{@i Something is digging tunnels under the city and your party has been asked to investigate.}

card.name: Nine of Intelligence
entries: Looking at how thoughts can create turmoil and finding a way to observe them from a dispassionate space of stillness.
{@i A mind flayer has used an intellect devourer to take over the prison warden. It uses him to prey on the prisoners.}

card.name: Nine of Strength
entries: Finding the wellspring of resolve to push through hardship. A test of faith.
{@i Evil from a haunted house has begun to blight the village farms in the valley below. Farmers have taken a collection to pay you to clear out the evil.}

card.name: Nine of Wisdom
entries: Finding the balance between enjoying our accomplishments and not slipping into complacency.
{@i A horde of marauders is rumoured to be en route to a village. The townsfolk ask the party for help.}

card.name: Page of Charisma
entries: Getting into action and rekindling a sense of adventure with even the small things. Realize what isn't working.
{@i Something has torn down the rope bridge that spans the chasm. The villagers need help rebuilding it.}

card.name: Page of Intelligence
entries: Discovering new ways of communicating your ideas and putting them into action.
{@i A wizard wants you to find her some rare spell components.}

card.name: Page of Strength
entries: It takes energy to do something awesome. Go for it! Engage your free spirit and follow your passion.
{@i A "holy" order of priests (actually evil) want you to retrieve a sacred object stolen from them. It's a unicorn's horn that was stolen by a real holy person.}

card.name: Page of Wisdom
entries: Embarking on a new path sparked by your curiosity and creativity.
{@i A man staggers toward you and hands you a silver key. He gasps, "find the fish," before falling over dead. He smells of brine.}

card.name: Queen of Charisma
entries: Creating a nurturing space for yourself and others to achieve greatness. Maintaining work/life balance.
{@i A farmer claims that his goose that lays golden eggs has been stolen by a cyclops and is asking for your help in getting it back.}

card.name: Queen of Intelligence
entries: The necessity to clearly communicate what you desire from a space of loving-kindness.
{@i Someone comes to you with a murder mystery that they want you to solve.}

card.name: Queen of Strength
entries: Spreading the love and letting your light shine. Having courage to take it to the next level.
{@i The party is asked to escort a political figure across a hostile terrain.}

card.name: Queen of Wisdom
entries: Going into the depth of compassion and quieting the critical mind to create emotional stability.
{@i A duck waddles up and says that he has witnessed a murder and wants you to catch the culprit.}

card.name: Seven of Charisma
entries: The power of allowing your plans to develop and unfold without urgency or restlessness.
{@i The town mayor is rumoured to be possessed by an evil spirit. The mayor is secretly preparing to sacrifice the entire town.}

card.name: Seven of Intelligence
entries: How we play games, hide our real selves, and mask our intentions out of fear or hurt.
{@i A doppelgänger has infiltrated the king's court and the king seeks someone who can root him out.}

card.name: Seven of Strength
entries: Dealing with the overwhelming. Letting go of what causes stress—perfectionism, desire, fear, future-tripping.
{@i You find a magical sword. Roll a {@dice d6}. 1–3: It's a +1 sword. 4–6: It's a +1 sword that when unsheathed sings loudly.}

card.name: Seven of Wisdom
entries: Our capacity to be discerning in our decisions and to choose from a place of clarity and wisdom.
{@i A librarian has discovered a hidden stone door covered with magical glyphs in the library's basement.}

card.name: Six of Charisma
entries: Giving and receiving fully while not sacrificing your values or exhausting your energy.
{@i An old Mariner tells you the precise location of a legendary shipwreck off the coast.}

card.name: Six of Intelligence
entries: Freeing yourself from burdens and old ways of thinking.
{@i A ghost approaches a member of the party claiming to be a long-dead relative. It seeks vengeance.}

card.name: Six of Strength
entries: Enjoy the success, but don't get attached to it. What's your definition of success? Riding the highs and lows.
{@i The party is asked to have a young person accompany the group on their next adventure as a coming-of-age ceremony.}

card.name: Six of Wisdom
entries: Our ability to become a child and play in the world. A return to innocence.
{@i You find a gem. When you turn toward a distant mountain, the gem pulsates and glows.}

card.name: Strength
entries: Your ability to move through fear to find the unshakable power within yourself.
{@i A burly warrior bars the way and challenges anyone to hand-to-hand combat.}

card.name: Temperance
entries: Our capacity to deal with something in a measured and patient way.
{@i You gain advantage on your next {@dice 1d6} Wisdom saving throws.}

card.name: Ten of Charisma
entries: The security that comes with having a network of people who support you and your dreams. Long-term success.
{@i A Paladin requests aid to recover the body of his fallen companion.}

card.name: Ten of Intelligence
entries: How we deal with what shows up in our lives. Do we avoid and deny? Do we react in anger? Do we remain conscious and aware?
{@i The mayor of the town is missing. She has been charmed by a vampire.}

card.name: Ten of Strength
entries: Making sure to speak up. Don't try to do it all. Delegate responsibility where you can. Express yourself.
{@i A benevolent order of druids wants their sacred stone back. It's in the crown of a pompous but powerful king.}

card.name: Ten of Wisdom
entries: Uniting the head and the heart. Relating to others and your environment in emotional balance.
{@i The party comes across a magical portal with a ring of standing stones.}

card.name: The Chariot
entries: Following through on your intentions and manifesting your desires.
{@i You find a trapped efreet who offers you his services for a year if you can find a way to free him.}

card.name: The Devil
entries: How we deal with our shadow self. This card calls us to cut through lies and see how honest we can be with ourselves.
{@i You encounter a devil who offers you a rare magic item in exchange for a favor.}

card.name: The Emperor
entries: Finding the source of your inner authority.
{@i You encounter a king of a far-off land who seeks your aid.}

card.name: The Empress
entries: Realizing your capacity to express beauty and to nurture others from a place of power.
{@i You encounter the queen of a nation with an important mission for you.}

card.name: The Fool
entries: Following your heart with innocence and wonder.
{@i You encounter a gnome who says that if you follow him, he'll lead you to a wondrous treasure.}

card.name: The Hanged Man
entries: The necessity to look at something from a different perspective.
{@i You have a strange dream of talking about life with an otyugh. When you wake up, you gain one permanent point of Wisdom.}

card.name: The Hermit
entries: Being a light unto yourself and finding your own way through the darkness.
{@i You meet a monk who is looking for worthy adventurers to defeat a magical monster.}

card.name: The Hierophant
entries: Using spiritual understanding and wisdom to perceive the world
{@i You find a holy book written by a wise sage that contains a cryptic secret hidden within it.}

card.name: The High Priestess
entries: Accessing your intuition and tuning in to the source of feminine power.
{@i You encounter a holy woman who offers you each a gift.}

card.name: The Lovers
entries: Finding harmony in relating with yourself and others while honoring your values.
{@i A mysterious person presents you with a tempting offer.}

card.name: The Magician
entries: Tapping into your genius to find new ways of looking at the world.
{@i You meet a sage who gives you a key that opens a magical lock.}

card.name: The Moon
entries: Facing and allowing deep-seated fears to dissolve in the light of your awareness. Remove words from the mind and breathe.
{@i You encounter a sorcerer who wants you to look into her crystal ball.}

card.name: The Star
entries: Finding something to focus on that can guide us through life. Our internal guidance system. Our North Star.
{@i You find a mechanical toy puppet that always walks to the nearest tavern.}

card.name: The Sun
entries: Returning to the innocence and vitality of childhood.
{@i Roll {@dice 1d6+6} that is now your age for the next seventy-two hours.}

card.name: The Tower
entries: The collapse of beliefs or material structures that we hold dear. It is in the nonresistance where we can find peace and wisdom.
{@i The Earth around you mysteriously begins to shake in a violent earthquake.}

card.name: The Wheel of Fortune
entries: A turning point in your destiny and your ability to adapt to change.
{@i You meet a halfling wizard who—If you treat him kindly—gives you a "wink of good luck." You gain advantage on your next role.}

card.name: The World
entries: Endings. Coming to a place of completion and power internally and externally.
{@i You see someone weeping at the side of the road. They are being forced to marry someone they don't want to.}

card.name: Three of Charisma
entries: Using the power of a team and learning how to collaborate.
{@i A shy ogre asks the party to rescue his pet goat from an evil cyclops.}

card.name: Three of Intelligence
entries: Finding a way to heal and learn from anxiety and emotional pain.
{@i A weeping dryad asks you to save her forest from destruction at the hands of orcs.}

card.name: Three of Strength
entries: Expanding your circle of influence and communicating your ideas. Making progress
{@i A young paladin-in-training says that his order has stolen an object sacred to hobgoblins. He feels guilty and wants to steal it and give it back to them.}

card.name: Three of Wisdom
entries: Taking time to celebrate the simple joy of aliveness with your friends.
{@i You were invited by the mayor of a nearby town to take part in their "Festival of Monsters".}

card.name: Two of Charisma
entries: Our ability to manage our time with grace and ease by getting clear on our priorities.
{@i A group of Viking Warriors are in a longboat. They claim to found a way to the river Styx, and they're going to fight devils.}

card.name: Two of Intelligence
entries: How our inner monologue causes confusion, and how we must find a way to listen to our heart.
{@i You see a lever that is inscribed with magical symbols. Do you pull it?}

card.name: Two of Strength
entries: Growing and making progress toward a future goal. Enjoy discovering what you love to do.
{@i A drunken beggar in an alley swears to you he saw the king's son turn into a werewolf. There have been grisly killings in the city.}

card.name: Two of Wisdom
entries: Being able to be with someone—whether a friend or lover—and still retain your own sense of individuality.
{@i You are approached by the captain of the city guard to see if you will track down and capture a dangerous criminal.}

card.name: I'jin
entries: {@i (pronounced EYE-jin)}
I'jin the {@creature Almiraj|ToA}, is fickle and unpredictable.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by I'jin, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I never stick to a plan."

entries.name: Power
entries: While I'jin inhabits you, your Dexterity score becomes 23 unless it is already higher.

card.name: Kubazan
entries: {@i (pronounced KOO-bah-zahn)}
Kubazan the {@creature Froghemoth|VGM}, is wild and spirited.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Kubazan, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I am fearless and not afraid to take great risks."

entries.name: Power
entries: While Kubazan inhabits you, your Strength score becomes 23 unless it is already higher.

card.name: Moa
entries: {@i (pronounced MOH-ah)}
Moa the {@creature Jaculi|ToA}, is truthful and kind.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Moa, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I must always speak the truth."

entries.name: Power
entries: While inhabited by Moa, you can use an action to turn {@condition invisible}. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on your person. The effect ends if you attack, cast a spell, force a saving throw, or deal damage.

card.name: Nangnang
entries: {@i (pronounced NANG-nang)}
Nangnang the {@creature Grung|VGM}, is selfish and cruel.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Nangnang, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I won't share with others."

entries.name: Power
entries: While inhabited by Nangnang, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You also gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

card.name: Obo'laka
entries: {@i (pronounced oh-boh-LAH-kah)}
Obo'laka the {@creature Zorbo|ToA}, is nervous and obsessive.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Obo'laka, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I am risk-averse and a slave to routine."

entries.name: Power
entries: While Obo'laka inhabits you, you can attune to one additional magic item. When Obo'laka leaves you, all magic items to which you are attuned are no longer attuned to you.

card.name: Papazotl
entries: {@i (pronounced pah-pah-ZAH-tul)}
Papazotl the {@creature Eblis|ToA}, is shrewd and conniving.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Papazotl, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I bow before no one and expect others to do as I command."

entries.name: Power
entries: While inhabited by Papazotl, you can't be surprised, you gain advantage on all Wisdom checks, and you never take damage from falling.

card.name: Shagambi
entries: {@i (pronounced shah-GOM-bee)}
Shagambi the {@creature Kamadan|ToA}, is wise and virtuous.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Shagambi, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I never show mercy to evildoers."

entries.name: Power
entries: While inhabited by Shagambi, you can make one extra attack when taking the {@action Attack} action on your turn.

card.name: Unkh
entries: {@i (pronounced UNK)}
Unkh the {@creature Flail Snail|VGM}, is self-absorbed and indecisive.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Unkh, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I am incapable of making decisions."

entries.name: Power
entries: While Unkh inhabits you, your Constitution score becomes 23 unless it is already higher.

card.name: Wongo
entries: {@i (pronounced WONG-go)}
Wongo the {@creature Su-monster|ToA}, is violent and deranged.

entries.name: Flaw
entries: While inhabited by Wongo, you gain the following flaw, which overrides any opposing flaw: "I act without concern for the well-being of others."

entries.name: Power
entries: While inhabited by Wongo, you can use your action to unleash a psionic assault on a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

table.name: Damage Types
rows: The corrosive spray of a black dragon's breath and the dissolving enzymes secreted by a black pudding deal acid damage.
Blunt force attacks—hammers, falling, constriction, and the like—deal bludgeoning damage.
The infernal chill radiating from an ice devil's spear and the frigid blast of a white dragon's breath deal cold damage.
Red dragons breathe fire, and many spells conjure flames to deal fire damage.
Force is pure magical energy focused into a damaging form. Most effects that deal force damage are spells, including magic missile and spiritual weapon.
A lightning bolt spell and a blue dragon's breath deal lightning damage.
Necrotic damage, dealt by certain undead and some spells, withers matter and even the soul.
Puncturing and impaling attacks, including spears and monsters' bites, deal piercing damage.
Venomous stings and the toxic gas of a green dragon's breath deal poison damage.
Mental abilities such as a mind flayer's psionic blast deal psychic damage.
Radiant damage, dealt by a cleric's flame strike spell or an angel's smiting weapon, sears the flesh like fire and overloads the spirit with power.
Swords, axes, and monsters' claws deal slashing damage.
A concussive burst of sound, such as the effect of the thunderwave spell, deals thunder damage.
